description: Department of Forest Conservation - Notify the Agrabopath Conservation Forest
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of a conservation forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It cites specific legislation (Chapter 451, No. 13 of 1966) and subsequent amendments, and exercises powers vested by law to declare a protected area. The content focuses on establishing a legal framework for forest conservation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
